documents.name: northstar-leave-policy.txt
documents.text:
Northstar Labs — People Handbook, effective 1 January 2026. This is a fictional demonstration company.
Annual leave: Full-time employees receive 24 paid vacation days per calendar year. Up to 6 unused days carry into the next year and must be used by 31 March. Contractors do not receive paid vacation through this policy. Leave requests go to the employee manager at least 10 business days before departure. Medical leave is covered by a separate policy; this document does not specify its allowance.
Remote work: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week. International remote work requires advance approval from People Operations. The handbook does not name individual managers or list salaries.

documents.name: northstar-expenses-2025.txt
documents.text:
Northstar Labs — ARCHIVED expense policy. Effective 1 January through 31 December 2025. This document is superseded by the 2026 expense policy.
The meal reimbursement limit was $35 per day in 2025. Receipts had to be submitted within 14 days. Travel required manager approval. These limits are historical and must not be applied to trips in 2026.

documents.name: northstar-expenses-2026.txt
documents.text:
Northstar Labs — CURRENT expense policy, effective 1 January 2026. Replaces the archived 2025 expense policy.
For trips on or after 1 January 2026, the meal reimbursement limit is $55 per day. Receipts must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the purchase. The meal allowance excludes alcohol. Exceptions require Finance approval before the expense. The policy does not provide a hotel nightly limit. All example amounts describe a fictional company.

documents.name: atlas-project-brief.txt
documents.text:
Northstar Labs — Atlas project brief, approved 12 September 2026.
The Atlas launch date is 18 November 2026. The project owner is Mira Chen. The approved budget is $48,000, including a $6,000 contingency reserve. Phase one includes document search and source citations. Mobile applications are out of scope for phase one. The launch depends on completing the security review by 4 November 2026. This brief does not guarantee launch if that review fails.

documents.name: gateway-incident-runbook.txt
documents.text:
Northstar Labs — Gateway incident runbook.
Error E42 means the gateway service certificate has expired. The operator must first renew the certificate, then restart the gateway, and finally confirm that the health check passes. Do not disable certificate verification. Error E17 instead indicates an upstream timeout and requires checking the upstream service. Neither error authorizes deleting databases. Escalate unresolved incidents to the on-call operations engineer.
